rows.description: `Inference.ts` extraction pattern is located and documented with exact file path, line number, and current regex/parse logic — confirming whether it is vulnerable to the array-blind bug
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -nE 'regex|extract|JSON\.parse|match' src/**/Inference.ts` returns the relevant line; file path and line number recorded in a `findings.md`

rows.description: Extraction function updated to handle both `{...}` object and `[...]` array top-level JSON; change is ≤5 LOC; no `any` types introduced; return type is properly generic
rows.verifyMethod: `git diff` shows only Inference.ts changed; TypeScript compiles with `tsc --noEmit` zero errors; return type annotation is `T | T[]` or equivalent generic

rows.description: Unit test suite includes ≥4 cases: (a) object extraction works, (b) array extraction works, (c) malformed JSON returns null, (d) nested arrays inside objects are unaffected
rows.verifyMethod: `npm test` exits 0; test output shows all 4 cases passing with descriptive labels

rows.description: Blast-radius audit produces a documented list of all skills categorized as `affected` (expects array), `safe` (expects object), or `unknown` (dynamic/unclear) — covering all skills in `skills/`
rows.verifyMethod: File `docs/array-blast-radius.md` exists; every skill directory has exactly one entry; no skill is missing from the list

rows.description: At least 2 skills from the `affected` category are smoke-tested with a mock LLM array response and confirmed to return the correct parsed array (not null, not empty)
rows.verifyMethod: Test output or manual run log shows skill name, input mock, and actual returned value — both returning non-null arrays

rows.description: No regressions: all pre-existing passing tests continue to pass after the patch is applied
rows.verifyMethod: `npm test` full suite exits 0; CI output (or local run) shows same pass count as before patch for non-new tests

rows.description: `findings.md` documents the resolution: vulnerability confirmed or not, patch applied, affected skill count, and any skills requiring follow-up
rows.verifyMethod: File exists at `docs/inference-array-fix-findings.md`; sections: Vulnerability Status, Patch Summary, Affected Skills Count, Follow-up Items
